recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片（cytospin）乾淨背景中，出現數顆中等大小、核質比高、染色質細緻且核有凹陷的單一型態母細胞，而不是成熟小淋巴球或單核球。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cells, roughly 1.5-2x the diameter of adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round to indented/cleaved nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous to small; no cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Monotonous population on a clean, acellular background with a few crenated red cells
describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a paucicellular, clean background containing a monotonous population of medium-sized blasts. The cells have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Mature small lymphocytes, monocytes and neutrophils are not seen in this field. In a patient with known B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with CNS involvement by B-lymphoblastic leukemia, confirmed by flow cytometry (CD19+, CD10+, CD22+).

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF lymphocytes are a mixed population with mature condensed chromatin and variable cytoplasm, not uniform fine-chromatin blasts.
Monocytoid cells have more abundant grey vacuolated cytoplasm and folded nuclei with lower N:C ratio.

ddx.dx: Traumatic tap with peripheral blood contamination
ddx.vs: A bloody tap shows numerous red cells with blood-proportional leukocytes, whereas this sample is clean with a predominant blast population.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by AML or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology alone cannot reliably separate lineage; flow cytometry showing CD19/CD10/CD22 without myeloid markers establishes B-lymphoblasts.
